d: Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination’ in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona’s rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world’s most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long-lasting, and cruelty-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi-faceted jeweled bottles.

To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent by providing the most innovative & luxurious fragrances, education, and sharing Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.

As KAYALI continues to scale its direct-to-consumer business across the US, UK, Europe and International markets, we are looking for a Growth Marketing Executive to join the D2C team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong interest in digital marketing who enjoys combining analysis, coordination and channel optimisation to drive business growth.
